description: This file defines a generic internal class LogViewAdaptor for Orleans' event sourcing system, which manages log views with batching, e-tags, and notification processing, including reading and writing state asynchronously, handling notifications, and error management.

classes.name: LogViewAdaptor<TLogView, TLogEntry>
classes.description: A generic internal class that adapts log views for Orleans event sourcing, handling state persistence, notifications, and concurrency control.

classes.name: UpdateStateStorageFailed
classes.description: A sealed class representing a failure during state storage write operations.

classes.name: ReadFromStateStorageFailed
classes.description: A sealed class representing a failure during state storage read operations.

classes.name: UpdateNotificationMessage
classes.description: A sealed class representing a notification message sent after updates, including version, origin, updates list, and ETag.

methods.name: LastConfirmedView
methods.description: Returns the last confirmed log view state.

methods.name: GetConfirmedVersion
methods.description: Returns the confirmed version number of the log.

methods.name: InitializeConfirmedView
methods.description: Initializes the confirmed view with a given initial state.

methods.name: MakeSubmissionEntry
methods.description: Creates a submission entry for a given log entry.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads the state from storage with retry logic.

methods.name: WriteAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously writes the current state to storage with retry and verification.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges two notification messages if they are compatible.

methods.name: ProcessNotifications
methods.description: Processes queued notifications, applying updates to the view.

methods.name: enter_operation
methods.description: Debug helper to mark the start of an operation.

methods.name: exit_operation
methods.description: Debug helper to mark the end of an operation.
